{{Quote|I'm Gwynn. If you ever need to get any cargo off-world, I'm the person to call.|Gwynn|<ref name="Operation: Elrood (book)">[[Operation: Elrood (book)|''Operation: Elrood'']]</ref>}}
'''Gwynn''' was a small, portly [[Gender/Legends|woman]] who operated the business [[Gwynn Dispatch]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Elrood/Legends|Elrood]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents spoke with Gwynn in her office in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Elrooden]] while attempting to trace the Rebel operative [[Shondra Del]]. Gwynn gave the agents a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] message that Del had left for them, and she also handed them a business card.
